inspectionOrder: Recorded after original snapshot, fixed target, family reference and actual source collection inspection, before opening judge aesthetic criteria or feedback.

sourceInspection.construction: A plain 8-vertex red block base, 8-vertex blue-gray rail, 16-vertex barrel, 16-vertex silver muzzle and origin empty. The two cylinders point along the native Y axis. The base is broader than the newly declared attachment reserve.

originalSnapshot: The object reads as a dark axial tube with a silver end on a blue rail and two exposed red shoulders.
Large unmodulated planes and low-sided cylinders make the silhouette sharp and sparse.
The rail and base do not communicate a supported mechanical cradle.
fixedTarget: The axial dark barrel remains the dominant functional feature, with a distinct silver muzzle.
Rounded red side housings, yellow bands and a continuous yellow cradle provide the warm cartoon construction.
Broad bevels, soft highlights and sparse silver fasteners give scale without painted texture.
The long shape and front/back relationship are retained, while the construction is substantially richer than the source.
familyReference: Yellow is the main shared structural color, red is the secondary equipment color, and gunmetal/silver distinguish working joints.
Edges are rounded and highlights broad; concentrated tiny details should remain subordinate at intended size.
independentImplementationIntent: Build a narrow supported rear foot and raised yellow cradle within the frozen local reserve. Use actual rounded native geometry for red side housings, bands and fasteners. Keep the moving barrel and muzzle visually coherent, retaining the exact required recoil displacement table when read from the native contract.
approval: No aesthetic verdict or approval is asserted.
